validity.researcher_notes: The pipeline is real and under construction. Length 828 km is stated by two sources. The completion year is 2027 in a May 2025 ministry statement and 2029 in March 2024 articles. The 28 bcm per year capacity on the sheet is the figure for the whole Eastern Gas System and no page read gives a figure for this section alone.
